lexemes.action_hints_menu_aria_description: Check your progress or reveal cells
lexemes.blind_incorrect_message: Unlucky. It's not quite right yet...
lexemes.blind_rule_break_operatorCross: Cells joined by a × must hold different symbols.
lexemes.blind_rule_break_operatorEqual: Cells joined by an = must hold the same symbol.
lexemes.blind_rule_break_threeInRow: Three of the same symbol in a row or column isn't allowed.
lexemes.blind_rule_break_tooMany: Each row and column needs an equal number of each symbol.
lexemes.blind_rule_break_duplicate: No two rows or columns can be identical.
lexemes.general_rotate_message: This viewport size isn't supported. Please try rotating your device.
lexemes.grid_description: A Takuzu grid: fill in 0s and 1s so no more than two of the same digit appear consecutively, each row and column contains an equal number of 0s and 1s, and no two rows or columns are the same.
lexemes.hint_reason_three_adjacent: Two of the same symbol already sit next to each other in this row or column — a third here would make three in a row.
lexemes.hint_reason_three_sandwich: Two of the same symbol sit either side of this cell — filling it the same way would make three in a row.
lexemes.hint_reason_operator_cross: A × sign joins this cell to a filled neighbour — cells linked by × must be different symbols.
lexemes.hint_reason_operator_equal: An = sign joins this cell to a filled neighbour — cells linked by = must be the same symbol.
lexemes.hint_reason_row_count: This row already has half its cells filled with one symbol — the rest must be the other.
lexemes.hint_reason_col_count: This column already has half its cells filled with one symbol — the rest must be the other.
lexemes.hint_reason_none: No hint available right now. Try filling in more cells.
lexemes.completion_stat_reveals_better_one: [[delta]] fewer cell revealed than last time
lexemes.completion_stat_reveals_better_other: [[delta]] fewer cells revealed than last time
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_01: Fill every cell of the grid with one of two symbols. Tap a cell to cycle between them.
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_02: No more than two of the same symbol can appear next to each other — in a row or in a column.
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_03: Each row and each column must contain an equal number of each symbol, and no two rows or columns can be the same.
lexemes.modal_onboarding_slide_04: Some cells are joined by a sign. Cells linked by an = must hold the same symbol; cells linked by a × must hold different symbols.
lexemes.guide_tour_more_body: Tap here for settings and more options.
lexemes.guide_rules_title: Do you know the rules of [[name]]?
lexemes.guide_tour_undo_body: Take back your last moves, one tap at a time.
lexemes.guide_tour_grid_body: Tap a square to cycle through the two symbols and back to empty.
lexemes.guide_tour_hints_body: Need a hand? Tap here for a hint, to check your grid, or to reveal answers.
lexemes.guide_tour_hint_body: Shows you the next square you can work out, and why.
lexemes.guide_tour_check_body: Check whether a square or the whole grid is right.
lexemes.guide_tour_reveal_body: Stuck? Reveal a square or the whole solution.
lexemes.guide_tour_settings_body: Print the puzzle, find How to play, and change settings such as the timer and auto-highlighting rule breaks.
lexemes.guide_tip_check: Don't forget you can check your grid here.
lexemes.guide_tip_hint: Stuck? Tap here for a hint.

lexemes.modal_print_setting_text_size_number: Adjust the grid number text size:
